items.name: Visual Whole-Body
items.summary: Learn locomotion and end-effector tracking, then train a task-specific visual policy.
items.note: Python 3.8 and the original Isaac Gym stack. Public research code under a non-commercial license; repository instructions have an outdated clone spelling. Use the repository link below.
steps: Read the low-level setup and B1Z1 configuration.
Train the low-level controller or retrieve the author-linked weights.
Set the low-level checkpoint in the high-level configuration, then follow the visual-policy training instructions.

items.name: RoboDuet
items.summary: Cooperative locomotion and manipulation policies with a two-stage training workflow.
items.note: Training commands support Go1 and Go2. Check the deployment section separately: the README describes deployment code as forthcoming.

items.name: UMI on Legs
items.summary: Combine human demonstrations with a manipulation-centric whole-body controller.
items.note: Includes controller training, deployment components, odometry and data-collection interfaces. Follow component-specific setup guides.

items.name: legged_gym
items.summary: A rough-terrain locomotion reference with domain randomization and an actuator model.
items.note: Locomotion foundation; adding an arm requires new assets, observations, actions and rewards. Maintainers recommend migration to Isaac Lab; this repository receives limited support.

items.name: OCS2
items.summary: Optimal control for switched systems, with robotics examples and MPC tooling.
items.note: A model-based starting point; no ready-made B1 + Z1 training pipeline is claimed.

items.name: DQ-Bench / DQ-Net
items.summary: Evaluate dynamic object grasping across four difficulty levels and seen/unseen objects.
items.note: Reports GSR, OSSR and TSC. Based on Visual Whole-Body; follow the repository task configurations. A repository-level license was not verified.

items.name: HumanoidBench
items.summary: Whole-body manipulation and locomotion tasks with environment and training code.
items.note: Useful for evaluation design; its embodiment differs from quadruped-arm systems, so scores are not directly comparable.

items.name: robosuite
items.summary: Reusable manipulation environments, robot models and controller interfaces.
items.note: Use for manipulation task design and controlled comparisons; quadruped locomotion is not its default setting.

items.name: Robot Viewer
items.summary: Inspect robot geometry, joint axes, collision shapes and inertial properties in your browser.
items.note: Start with the robot description and its mesh assets. USD support is partial; visual inspection alone does not validate dynamics.
steps: Open the viewer and load the model together with its referenced meshes.
Inspect joints, frames, collision geometry and inertial properties.
Check the same model in your target simulator before using it for training.

items.name: Isaac Lab
items.summary: Build reinforcement and imitation learning tasks with robot assets and reusable environment components.
items.note: Use the installation and compatibility guide for the selected release. The framework and simulator dependencies have separate terms.

items.name: MuJoCo
items.summary: Simulate contacts and articulated dynamics for model checks and policy evaluation.
items.note: Useful for sim-to-sim testing; match joint order, actuators, control rate and contact settings explicitly.

items.name: MuJoCo Menagerie
items.summary: Browse curated robot models to inspect reference geometry and simulator configurations.
items.note: Licenses vary by model. Read the individual model license and README before reuse; assets do not provide a trained controller.

items.name: Pinocchio
items.summary: Compute robot kinematics, rigid-body dynamics and derivatives for control and optimization.
items.note: Useful for FK/IK building blocks and model-based controllers; a complete tracking controller must be assembled separately.

items.name: MoveIt 2
items.summary: Plan collision-aware arm motions and configure manipulation pipelines.
items.note: A manipulation planning layer; quadruped balance and base coordination require a separate controller.

items.name: rsl_rl
items.summary: Reusable reinforcement learning components for robot-control training pipelines.
items.note: Match the library version to the baseline. Older Isaac Gym projects may pin an earlier API.
